headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: While Revenue grew by 4% YoY, EBITDA and PAT registered declines of 27% and 19% respectively on YoY basis.
This was primarily attributable to the 440 bps YoY decline in gross margins owing to higher costs of key raw materials like Pig iron, Aluminium, Steel and Copper.

The management stated that the compression in gross margins was more impacted by RM led inflation as compared to product mix.  Power Gen (PG) Segment: The domestic PG segment is benefitting from healthy demand from sectors such as manufacturing, data centres and residential and commercial realty.
Data centres vertical contributed to 30-40% of the revenue of the PG segment.
valuation: Slow execution was seen in the marine and the rail segment in Q2FY27 and some supply side shortages also impacted the compressor segment.  Valuation: The steep correction post the soft Q2FY27 performance makes valuations more reasonable.
